name: ai-toolbox-workbench
description: Local, observe-only inventory for AI capabilities and project-scoped Skills.

scripts.test:python: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.test:candidates: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_candidate_workbench.py' -v
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:python && npm run test:candidates
scripts.workbench: npm run build && npm run start
